task.name: Integer sets avoiding square pair sums, including diagonals
task.family: science prize b square sum free
task.description: Return nonempty subset of [1,256] such that a+b is never a perfect square for a<=b in the set, INCLUDING a=b. Maximize cardinality. Explicit diagonal-including restriction resolves the terse bank wording; all pairs are verified with integer square roots. It is distinct from square DIFFERENCE avoidance.
task.contract: construct() -> candidate. Return nonempty subset of [1,256] such that a+b is never a perfect square for a<=b in the set, INCLUDING a=b. Maximize cardinality.
